beats.text: An order for zero items just went through. Before we change the code, what should the validator do with zero?
Hold that answer. Open the test file and find the case for a single item.
Copy that test. Change the quantity to zero, and change the expected result to false.
Now run just that test. See the two values on the screen?
We expected false. We got true. That red line gives us a case we can reproduce.
Replace greater than or equal to zero with greater than zero. Run the same test again.
This time it passes. Before we call the fix complete, which neighboring value would you check next?
